newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to set up food safety watch body.
newsitem.headline: France to set up food safety watch body.

text.p: France plans to set up an inter-govermental body to monitor human and animal food safety, the farm ministry said on Wednesday.
The surveillance body comprised of scientific experts will be set up soon, the ministry said in a statement.
It will coordinate and assess the safety of food products and processes, be on the lookout for possible health risks and evaluate controls made by various administrations.
French farm and food minister Phillipe Vasseur stressed in the statement that "the minister in charge of food (services) remains responsible for the decisions and their implementation."
In a January 21 report on the crisis over mad cow disease, French parliamentary Jean-Francois Mattei had recommended the creation of a food safety unit.
